T PRASAD  AGED 30 YEARS, VAKKAYIL HOUSE,
 KANDALLOOR SOUTH, KANDALLOOR VILLAGE,
 ALAPPUZHA, KERALA, PIN - 690535 OTHER PRESENT:
 SR.PUBLIC PROSECUTOR-SRI.A.VIPIN NARAYAN  THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 02.12.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 Crl.M.C.8692/2025  2 Aswin vs State Of Kerala on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64824215/
1  2025:KER:93626  ORDER Dated this the 2nd day of December, 2025 Petitioner is the 4th accused in CC. No.778/2021 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Harippad.

The offences alleged against the petitioner and the other accused persons are under Sections 498A, 406 r/w 34 of IPC.
2.

The prosecution case is that the 1st accused being the husband of the defacto complainant and the other accused being his relatives subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally on the ground of dowry and appropriated her gold ornaments and thereby they are alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, in the FI statement, there is no specific allegations against the petitioner so as to constitute the offences alleged against the petitioner and therefore he prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
4.
The petition was strongly opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.

5. On a perusal of the FI statement, it can be seen that though several allegations are raised against the accused persons, as against the 2025:KER:93626 petitioner herein, there is no specific allegation with date and material particulars.
In the above circumstances, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioner as it will only be an abuse of the process of the court.
Therefore, further proceedings against the petitioner alone, is liable to be quashed by invoking the power under Section 528 of the BNSS.
In the result, this Crl. M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner herein, in CC.
No.778/2021 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Harippad, arising from crime No.200/2021 of Kanakakkunnu Police Station, Alappuzha, stands quashed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S. Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE sou.
